code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and out[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
